### Fig.2H-MHC-II

```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
MHC_IIdat <- IHCdat %>% dplyr::select(PID, MHC_II, AIT) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(MHC_II))

table(MHC_IIdat$AIT)
ggboxplot(MHC_IIdat, x = "AIT", y = "MHC_II", 
          fill = "AIT", width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = AIT_col) +
  stat_compare_means() + theme(legend.position = "") +
  ylab("MHC-II+ Malignant Cell (%)") 
```

### Fig.2K

```{r}
mhcMFI <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("./RData/Exp_MHC_INFG_MFI.xlsx", sheet = 1)
mhcMFI$IFNG <- str_remove(mhcMFI$IFNG, "ng/ml")
mhcMFI$IFNG <- paste0("D", mhcMFI$IFNG)
# remove NA
mhcMFI <- mhcMFI[!is.na(mhcMFI$MFI), ]
mhcMFI$CellLine <- plyr::mapvalues(mhcMFI$CellLine, 
                                   from = c("TPC1", "BCPAP"),
                                   to = c("TPC-1", "B-CPAP"))

mhcMFI %>% 
  ggbarplot(x = "CellLine", y = "MFI", add = "mean_se",
            fill = "IFNG", width = 0.8,
            position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  xlab("") + scale_fill_manual(values = IFNGcol) +
  ylab("MFI:MHC-I") + stat_compare_means(aes(group = IFNG))
```

### Fig.2M

```{r}
scratchdat <- readRDS("./RData/02_scratchdat.rds")
my_comparisons <- list(c("D10", "D0"), c("D100", "D0"))
plist <- list()
for (i in c("B-CPAP", "TPC-1")){
  plist[[i]] <- ggbarplot(scratchdat[scratchdat$CellLine == i, ], 
            x = "Time", y = "Rate", fill = "IFNG",
          add = "mean_se", 
          position = position_dodge(0.7),  width = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = IFNGcol) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0,vjust = 0,hjust = 1)) + xlab("") + ylab("Migration rate (%)") + 
    ggtitle(i) 
}
plist
```

p-value

```{r}
scratchdat$group <- paste0(scratchdat$CellLine, scratchdat$Time)
datlist <- split(scratchdat, scratchdat$group)
pvalues <- sapply(datlist, function(z){
  p1 <- t.test(Rate~IFNG, data = subset(z, IFNG != "D10"))$p.value
  p2 <- t.test(Rate~IFNG, data = subset(z, IFNG != "D100"))$p.value
  data.frame(IFNG100 = p1, IFN10 = p2)
})
pvalues
```

### Fig.3E-IFN-G

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
IFNGdat <- dplyr::select(IHCdat, PID, AIT, IFNG_NATCore, IFNG_TumorCore) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(is.na(IFNG_NATCore) & is.na(IFNG_TumorCore)))
na.omit(IFNGdat$IFNG_NATCore) %>% length() # 66
na.omit(IFNGdat$IFNG_TumorCore) %>% length() # 61
IFNGdat <- pivot_longer(IFNGdat, cols = IFNG_NATCore:IFNG_TumorCore, 
                        names_to = "Class", values_to = "H_score") %>% na.omit()
ggboxplot(IFNGdat,
            x = "Class", y = "H_score", 
          fill = "AIT", alpha = 1, width = 0.5) +
  xlab("") + scale_fill_manual(values = AIT_col) + 
  ylab("H score") +
  stat_compare_means(aes(group = AIT), method = "t.test",
                     method.args = list(alternative = "greater")) +
  ggtitle("IHC: IFN-γ score")
```

### Fig.4E

```{r fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
basedat <- readRDS("./RData/Exp_CoCulture_Killrate.rds")
basedat$CellLine <- factor(basedat$CellLine, levels = names(CLinecol))
ggbarplot(basedat,
            x = "Tcell", y = "MeanRate", add = "mean_se",
          fill = "CellLine", 
          position = position_dodge(0.7), alpha = 1, width = 0.5) +
  xlab("") + scale_fill_manual(values = CLinecol) + ylab("Killing Rate (%)") 
```

```{r}
# calculate p-vale: B-CPAP vs TPC-1
basedat$group2 <- ifelse(basedat$CellLine %in% c("TPC-1", "B-CPAP"),
                         "group1", "group2")

t.test(MeanRate~CellLine, subset = Tcell == "NT" & 
         CellLine %in% c("TPC-1", "B-CPAP"),
       data = basedat)
t.test(MeanRate~CellLine, subset = Tcell == "TT" & 
         CellLine %in% c("TPC-1", "B-CPAP"),
       data = basedat)
# calculate p-vale: B-CPAP vs TPC-1
t.test(MeanRate~group2, subset = Tcell == "NT", data = basedat)
t.test(MeanRate~group2, subset = Tcell == "TT", data = basedat)
```

### Fig.4G

```{r}
G4dat <- readRDS("./RData/Exp_CoCulture_ko.rds")
usecol <- colnames(G4dat)[2:ncol(G4dat)]
G4dat <- pivot_longer(G4dat, 
                      cols = all_of(usecol),
                      names_to = "Group", values_to = "lysis")
G4dat$Treatment <- str_split(G4dat$Group, "_") %>% 
  sapply(., "[[", 3)
G4dat$SampleGroup <- str_remove(G4dat$Group, "_[A-Za-z]+$")
# cell-line order
group_order <- c("TT_TPC1", "NT_TPC1", "TT_BCPAP", "NT_BCPAP")
treat_order <- c("TG", "TPO", "control")
G4dat$SampleGroup <- factor(G4dat$SampleGroup, levels = group_order)
G4dat$Treatment <- factor(G4dat$Treatment, levels = treat_order)
treatcol <- c("#33A02C", "#FF7F00", "#1F78B4")
names(treatcol) <- c("TG", "TPO", "control")
```



```{r fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
ggbarplot(G4dat,
            x = "SampleGroup", y = "lysis", add = "mean_se",
          fill = "Treatment", 
          position = position_dodge(0.7), alpha = 1, width = 0.5) +
  xlab("") + ylab("Killing Rate (%)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = treatcol) 
```

```{r}
G4dat.list <- split(G4dat, G4dat$SampleGroup)
G4dat.list$TT_TPC1
G4dat.list <- lapply(G4dat.list, function(z){
  dat <- pivot_wider(z, 
                     id_cols = ID, names_from = Treatment, 
                     values_from = lysis)
  TG_TPO <- t.test(dat$TG, dat$TPO, paired = TRUE)$p.value
  TG_control <- t.test(dat$TG, dat$control, paired = TRUE)$p.value
  TPO_control <- t.test(dat$TPO, dat$control, paired = TRUE)$p.value
  data.frame(Group = c("TG_TPO", "TG_control", "TPO_control"),
             Pvalue = c(TG_TPO, TG_control, TPO_control))
})
G4pvalue <- plyr::ldply(G4dat.list, .fun = "rbind")
G4pvalue$Pvalue <- round(G4pvalue$Pvalue, 3)
G4pvalue
```

### Fig.4H

```{r}
H4dat <- readRDS("./RData/Exp_CoCulture_AIT.rds")
pdat <- H4dat %>% pivot_longer(
  cols = all_of(c("TT_TPC1", "TN_TPC1")), 
  names_to = "Group", values_to = "Rate")
pdat$Pathology_AIT <- plyr::mapvalues(pdat$Pathology_AIT, 
                                      from = c(0, 1),
                                      to = c("AIT_No", "AIT_Yes"))
pdat$newgroup <- paste0(pdat$Group, "_", pdat$Pathology_AIT)
pdat$newgroup <- factor(pdat$newgroup, levels = c("TT_TPC1_AIT_Yes", 
                                                  "TT_TPC1_AIT_No",
                                                  "TN_TPC1_AIT_Yes",
                                                  "TN_TPC1_AIT_No"))
newGcol <- c("#E31A1C", "#FB9A99", "#1F78B4", "#A6CEE3")
names(newGcol) <- c("TT_TPC1_AIT_Yes", "TT_TPC1_AIT_No", 
                    "TN_TPC1_AIT_Yes","TN_TPC1_AIT_No")
table(pdat$Pathology_AIT)
pdat %>% 
  ggboxplot(.,
           x = "newgroup",
           y = "Rate",
           fill = "newgroup", 
           ylab = "rate", width = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = newGcol) + 
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("TT_TPC1_AIT_Yes", "TT_TPC1_AIT_No"),
                                        c("TN_TPC1_AIT_Yes", "TN_TPC1_AIT_No")),
                     method = "t.test") +
  
  NoLegend() + xlab("") + ylab("Killing Rate (%)")
```


### Fig.6E

```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
cxcl9_ihc <- dplyr::select(IHCdat, PID, AIT, IFNG_invasive, CXCL9_invasive)
cxcl9_ihc <- cxcl9_ihc %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(is.na(IFNG_invasive) & is.na(CXCL9_invasive)))
ggscatter(cxcl9_ihc, x = "CXCL9_invasive", y = "IFNG_invasive", 
          color = "AIT", size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = AIT_col) +
  stat_cor(method = "pearson") + 
  xlab("CXCL9 H-score in Tumor Invasion Margin") +
  ylab("Density of IFN-γ+ Cells in \nTumor Invasion Margin")
```

### Fig.6I

```{r fig.width=3, fig.height=3}
dat <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("./RData/Exp_CXCL9ELISA.xlsx", sheet = 2)
dat$INFG <- paste0("D", dat$INFG)
colnames(dat)[1] <- "IFNG"
tmpcol <- IFNGcol
names(tmpcol)[2] <- "D20"
ggbarplot(dat, x = "IFNG", y = "CXCL9", add = "mean_se",
          width = 0.5,
          position = position_dodge(0.8), alpha = 0.5, fill = "IFNG") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tmpcol) + 
  xlab("") + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ylab("ELISA: CXCL9 ng/mL") +
  stat_compare_means(aes(label = paste0("p = ", after_stat(p.format))),
    comparisons = list(c("D100", "D20"), c("D20", "D0")),
                     method = "t.test")
```

### Fig.6J

```{r fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
chemodat <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("./RData/Exp_chemotatic.xlsx", sheet = 2)
usecol <-  colnames(chemodat)[-1]
chemodat <- pivot_longer(chemodat, cols = all_of(usecol),
                         names_to = "Tcell", values_to =  "rate") %>% as.data.frame()

my_comparisons <- list(c("FBS_CXCL9", "FBS"), 
                       c("FBS_M1_20", "FBS_CXCL9"),
                        c("FBS_M1_100", "FBS_CXCL9"),
                       c("FBS_M1_100_CXCL9Ab", "FBS_CXCL9"), c("FBS_M1_100_CXCR3Ab","FBS_CXCL9"),
                      c("FBS_M1_100", "FBS_M1_100_CXCL9Ab"),
                      c("FBS_M1_100_CXCL9Ab", "FBS_M1_100_CXCR3Ab")
                       )
mycols <-  brewer.pal(12, "Paired")
plist <- list()
for (z in c("TT", "NT")){
    plist[[z]] <- ggbarplot(chemodat[chemodat$Tcell == z , ], 
          x = "Group", y = "rate", add = "mean_se",
          fill = "Group", 
          position = position_dodge(0.8), alpha = 0.5, width = 0.5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = mycols) + 
  ggtitle(z) +
      RotatedAxis() + 
      xlab("") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + ylab("Migration Rate%") + 
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons, 
                     method = "t.test",
                     label.y.npc = 0.8)
}
plist$TT
```
